exposure: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF)
hypertension (chronic hypertension and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy)
cohort: Women with pregnancy-related hospitalizations in the United States between 2002 and 2014.
finding: The prevalence of pregnancy-related HFpEF hospitalizations increased by 19.4% from 2002 to 2014, and women with HFpEF were 2.61-6.47 times more likely to experience adverse pregnancy outcomes.
cross-section timing: Cases were observed antepartum (17%), during delivery (27%), and postpartum (56%) within pregnancy-related hospitalizations from 2002 through 2014.
